# Ayush Yadav — Portfolio

> Personal portfolio for Ayush Yadav (R&D Software Engineer II, Cadence Design Systems).
> Deployed at https://binaryphoenix.vercel.app. Built with Next.js 16 App Router,
> React 19, TypeScript 6 strict, Tailwind CSS 4, next-intl 4 (six locales at one URL),
> Zod 4, Resend (with attachments), Vitest, Playwright, plus Vercel Web Analytics +
> Speed Insights (both cookie-less). Proprietary license — viewable for personal study;
> do not copy, fork-publish, or train ML models on.

This `llms.txt` follows the [llmstxt.org](https://llmstxt.org/) convention: a curated
index of the most useful files for language models exploring this repository. Read the
project entry-points first, then drill into the categories below.

## Project entry-points

- [README.md](README.md): User-facing overview — stack, env vars, scripts, deploy, license.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): **Authoritative rules for any AI coding agent.** Read first.
- [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): High-level architecture, render strategy, i18n sequence diagram.
- [docs/DESIGN_GUIDE.md](docs/DESIGN_GUIDE.md): Design tokens, component anatomy, motion rules, perf budgets.
- [docs/CONTRIBUTING.md](docs/CONTRIBUTING.md): Local setup, hooks, definition of done, dotfile reference.
- [docs/ROADMAP.md](docs/ROADMAP.md): Now / Next / Later items and what's already shipped.
- [docs/CHANGELOG.md](docs/CHANGELOG.md): Notable changes per release.
- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md): Reporting channels, scope, hardening summary.
- [LICENSE](LICENSE): Proprietary terms.

## Architecture decision records

- [docs/ADR/0001-record-architecture-decisions.md](docs/ADR/0001-record-architecture-decisions.md): Why ADRs.
- [docs/ADR/0002-nextjs-app-router.md](docs/ADR/0002-nextjs-app-router.md): Next.js 16 + TypeScript + Tailwind.
- [docs/ADR/0003-testing-vitest-playwright.md](docs/ADR/0003-testing-vitest-playwright.md): Two-tier test pyramid.
- [docs/ADR/0004-i18n-next-intl.md](docs/ADR/0004-i18n-next-intl.md): next-intl + `localePrefix: "never"`.

## Source of truth (content)

- [src/content/profile.ts](src/content/profile.ts): Name, role, links, taglines.
- [src/content/experience.ts](src/content/experience.ts): Cadence role, internships, education.
- [src/content/projects.ts](src/content/projects.ts): Case studies — problem / challenge / approach / impact / stack.
- [src/content/skills.ts](src/content/skills.ts): Capability clusters (with related projects).
- [src/content/skills-flat.ts](src/content/skills-flat.ts): Flat skill categories for the explorer.
- [src/content/achievements.ts](src/content/achievements.ts): CP ratings + other awards.
- [src/content/concepts.ts](src/content/concepts.ts): Concept Lab entries (roadmap).
- [src/content/metrics.ts](src/content/metrics.ts): Homepage impact strip.
- [src/content/extras.ts](src/content/extras.ts): Honors, languages, volunteering.
- [src/content/quotes.ts](src/content/quotes.ts): Programming quotes for the footer cycler.

## App router & API

- [src/app/layout.tsx](src/app/layout.tsx): Root layout, fonts, `<html lang>`.
- [src/app/[locale]/layout.tsx](src/app/%5Blocale%5D/layout.tsx): Locale layout, theme, providers, JSON-LD.
- [src/app/[locale]/page.tsx](src/app/%5Blocale%5D/page.tsx): Home page composition (recruiter-aware).
- [src/app/[locale]/work/page.tsx](src/app/%5Blocale%5D/work/page.tsx): Work index with GitHub workbench.
- [src/app/[locale]/work/[slug]/page.tsx](src/app/%5Blocale%5D/work/%5Bslug%5D/page.tsx): Project case-study template.
- [src/app/api/contact/route.ts](src/app/api/contact/route.ts): Contact API — Zod + rate-limit + Resend.
- [src/app/sitemap.ts](src/app/sitemap.ts): One URL per route (URLs are locale-agnostic).
- [src/app/robots.ts](src/app/robots.ts): Robots policy.
- [src/app/manifest.ts](src/app/manifest.ts): Web App Manifest (PWA install metadata).
- [src/app/opengraph-image.tsx](src/app/opengraph-image.tsx): Edge OG image generator.
- [src/app/[locale]/privacy/page.tsx](src/app/%5Blocale%5D/privacy/page.tsx): Translated privacy policy page.
- [src/app/[locale]/not-found.tsx](src/app/%5Blocale%5D/not-found.tsx): Improved 404 with suggestions + ASCII phoenix.
- [src/proxy.ts](src/proxy.ts): next-intl proxy (Next 16's middleware rename).

## i18n

- [src/i18n/routing.ts](src/i18n/routing.ts): Locale list, `localePrefix: "never"`, detection on.
- [src/i18n/navigation.ts](src/i18n/navigation.ts): Locale-aware `Link`, `useRouter`, `redirect`.
- [src/i18n/request.ts](src/i18n/request.ts): Message loader with deep-merge English fallback.
- [messages/en.json](messages/en.json): Source of truth for translations.

## Libraries

- [src/lib/validation.ts](src/lib/validation.ts): Zod 4 schemas (codes mapped to translations on the client; includes Collaborator + Other-specify + attachment limits).
- [src/lib/email.ts](src/lib/email.ts): Resend integration with attachments + explicit `{ data, error }` surfacing (silent-error fix).
- [src/lib/rate-limit.ts](src/lib/rate-limit.ts): Token-bucket IP rate limiter (emits `Retry-After` via the route).
- [src/lib/feeds.ts](src/lib/feeds.ts): Medium / YouTube / GitHub feed adapters.
- [src/lib/github.ts](src/lib/github.ts): Featured-repos fetcher with curated fallback.
- [src/lib/utils.ts](src/lib/utils.ts): `cn`, `slugify`, accent-class maps.

## UX surfaces worth knowing

- [src/components/layout/settings-menu.tsx](src/components/layout/settings-menu.tsx): Consolidated header overflow (language + theme + recruiter + shortcuts).
- [src/components/layout/keyboard-shortcuts.tsx](src/components/layout/keyboard-shortcuts.tsx): Global keymap + `?` help overlay.
- [src/components/layout/cookie-consent.tsx](src/components/layout/cookie-consent.tsx): Soft cookie notice with privacy link.
- [src/components/contact/attachment-field.tsx](src/components/contact/attachment-field.tsx): Drag-and-drop file picker.
- [src/components/projects/project-demo.tsx](src/components/projects/project-demo.tsx): Lazy-loaded per-project demo wrapper.
